description: Baseline 2: XGBoost with carefully engineered temporal features (lag, rolling statistics, change rates). Shows that even with good feature engineering, end-to-end learning can still outperform. Expected RMSE: 2.5-3.5%

training.note: XGBoost uses its own training mechanism via fit() method, not epoch-based training

lag_features.description: Previous t-1, t-2, ..., t-10 cycles to preserve temporal order

raw_features.description: Last cycle raw features as reference

purpose: Strong baseline to demonstrate the advantage of CNN-LSTM's automatic feature learning over manual feature engineering

expected_performance.note: Better than simple XGBoost but should still be outperformed by CNN-LSTM to prove the value of end-to-end learning
